goal: After P131, the cockpit's ELI5 narration (Get-LocalClaudeEli5 in sgsd-codex-monitor.ps1) prompts the Haiku narrator for a 4-beat Duarte arc (What is now / What could be / S.T.A.R. moment / Call to action) and writes in common words. A mechanical Node lint module (eli5-lint.cjs) validates ELI5 text against a 1539-word allowlist (Munroe ten-hundred + SGSD vocabulary). Inline-gloss patterns (parens or em-dash) are recognized so technical terms can be introduced with their plain-words definition. Lint is informational at this phase; binding promotion deferred to P134.

decisions.decision: Original SAC-P131-03 asked for absolute count comparison (glossed text fewer violations than bare). Orchestrator refined T4's test to check the glossed-flag boolean directly on the orchestrator violation entry — the gloss text itself can contain non-common words that confound count comparison. Same spec-intent (gloss-detection works), more robust test.

consumers: P132 (localhost-live cockpit serves the ELI5 panel)
constraints: common-words.txt is the single source of truth for 'common'
extension_points: common-words.txt can be appended without breaking lint contract
maxViolations is per-call configurable via opts
